subject: Report group description entry
notes: kb/Work PB565 (vertical axis). ALL THREE of GR3's repetition vehicles are live: 'An entry that contains either an OCCURS clause or a LINE or COLUMN clause with more than one operand is said to be a repeating entry, and the number of repetitions is defined to be integer-2 of the OCCURS clause or the number of operands of the LINE or COLUMN clause, whichever is applicable.' EntryRepetitions computes the count from the entry's own clauses (the OCCURS integer-2 times a multiple COLUMN operand count; a multiple LINE clause cannot join either, 13.18.35.3 SR10d), RepetitionChain reads 'an entry that is subordinate to a repeating entry' off the entry scope stack, and the count is what 13.18.63.3 SR35 / 13.18.53.3 SR6 screen against. 'The number of repetitions of an entry that is not a repeating entry is defined to be 1' is the default both helpers take. Golden lines 30-31 exercise a repeating entry subordinate to a repeating entry on the other axis.
